blocks.zh: 掌握 §211.122 標籤物料審查與核准的書面程序要求，理解連版標籤（gang-printed labeling）的特殊管制規定及裁切標籤的識別義務
blocks.en: Understand the written-procedure requirements of §211.122 for examination and approval of labeling materials, the special controls for gang-printed labeling, and the obligation to identify cut labels

blocks.en: Understand the strict control of labeling issuance under §211.125, including the 100% label reconciliation obligation, destruction of returned labels, and integration with electronic batch records

blocks.zh: 熟悉 §211.130 包裝與標籤操作的線清（line clearance）規範，掌握防止標籤混淆的系統性控制設計；了解 §211.134 成品外觀檢查要求
blocks.en: Become familiar with the line clearance requirements for packaging and labeling operations under §211.130 and the systematic control design that prevents label mix-ups; understand the finished-product inspection requirement of §211.134

blocks.zh: 理解 §211.132 防竄改包裝要求對 OTC 藥品的強制適用，以及相關豁免條件
blocks.en: Understand how §211.132 makes tamper-evident packaging mandatory for OTC drug products, and the related exemptions

blocks.zh: 深入理解 §211.137 有效期限的法規根據——穩定性數據支撐原則（ICH Q1A/Q1E）、格式要求、各豁免類型及 CDMO 責任歸屬
blocks.en: Gain a deeper understanding of the regulatory basis for expiration dating under §211.137: the principle that stability data must support the date (ICH Q1A/Q1E), format requirements, the exemption types, and CDMO responsibility

blocks.zh: 掌握 §§211.142 & 211.150 的倉儲與配送書面程序要求，包括 FIFO/FEFO 原則、溫控管理（USP <1079>）與召回追溯配送記錄設計
blocks.en: Master the written-procedure requirements for warehousing and distribution under §§211.142 & 211.150, including the FIFO/FEFO principles, temperature control (USP <1079>), and the design of distribution records that support recall traceability

blocks.zh: 從 CDMO 視角分析多客戶標籤管控、冷鏈品質協議及配送記錄責任分工的實務架構
blocks.en: Analyze, from the CDMO perspective, the practical framework for multi-client label control, cold chain quality agreements, and the division of responsibility for distribution records

blocks.zh: 4.1 §211.122 — Labeling Materials: Examination and Usage Criteria（標籤物料審查與使用準則）
blocks.en: 4.1 §211.122 — Labeling Materials: Examination and Usage Criteria

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Regulatory Text
blocks.en: Regulatory Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 為什麼標籤混淆是 FDA 最常見的召回原因？
blocks.en: Why are label mix-ups the most common cause of FDA recalls?

blocks.zh: 根據 FDA 的年度召回數據，labeling mix-up（標籤混淆）長期位居召回原因前三名——幾乎每年都有製造廠因錯誤貼標（wrong label affixed to product）發出 Class I Recall（最高風險等級召回）。貼錯標籤的藥品可能使患者服用錯誤藥物或錯誤劑量，輕則治療無效，重則危及生命。正因如此，Subpart G 建立了多層次的預防機制，從物料入廠一路管控到成品出廠。
blocks.en: According to FDA's annual recall data, labeling mix-ups have long ranked among the top three causes of recalls. Almost every year, some manufacturer issues a Class I recall (the highest-risk recall class) because the wrong label was affixed to a product. A drug with the wrong label can lead a patient to take the wrong drug or the wrong dose, which at best means no therapeutic effect and at worst endangers life. For this reason, Subpart G builds multiple layers of prevention, controlling labeling from receipt of materials through release of the finished product.

blocks.zh: §211.122 建立的是「入庫即管控」的邏輯：標籤物料從供應商收到的那一刻起，就必須有書面程序管理收料、鑑別、儲存、取樣、審查及核准或拒絕。任何一個環節的失控都可能讓錯誤標籤流入生產線。
blocks.en: §211.122 is built on the logic of "control from the moment of receipt": from the moment labeling materials are received from the supplier, there must be written procedures governing receipt, identification, storage, handling, sampling, examination, and approval or rejection. A failure at any single step can let the wrong label reach the production line.

blocks.zh: 連版標籤（Gang-Printed Labeling）的風險與管控
blocks.en: Risks and Controls for Gang-Printed Labeling

blocks.zh: Gang-printed labeling 指同一張印刷紙上同時印有不同產品、不同規格或不同含量的標籤。這在印刷成本上有優勢，但混淆風險極高——一旦裁切程序出錯，操作人員可能取用錯誤規格的標籤。
blocks.en: Gang-printed labeling means labeling printed on a single sheet that carries labels for different products, different strengths, or different dosage levels. It saves printing cost but carries a very high mix-up risk: if the cutting step goes wrong, an operator may pick up a label of the wrong strength.

blocks.zh: §211.122(f) 明文禁止未加差異化的連版標籤，唯有在各標籤已透過尺寸（size）、形狀（shape）或顏色（color）有足夠差異化識別時才允許例外。實務上，大多數合規製造廠選擇完全避免連版標籤，改用單一產品/規格專用標籤卷（dedicated label rolls），根本消除此風險。自動化貼標系統配合條碼驗證（bar code verification）可進一步提供額外保護層。
blocks.en: §211.122(f) prohibits gang-printed labeling unless the labels are adequately differentiated by size, shape, or color. In practice, most compliant manufacturers avoid gang-printed labeling entirely and use dedicated label rolls for a single product/strength, which eliminates the risk at its source. Automated labeling systems combined with bar code verification add a further layer of protection.

blocks.zh: 標籤物料規格（Label Specification）的內容
blocks.en: Contents of the Label Specification

blocks.zh: §211.122(b) 要求有「適當書面規格（appropriate written specifications）」。一份完整的標籤規格應涵蓋：
blocks.en: §211.122(b) requires "appropriate written specifications". A complete label specification should cover:

blocks.zh: 視覺/文字要求： 字體、字號、顏色色碼（Pantone 或 CMYK 值）、版面配置、必要法定聲明
blocks.en: Visual/text requirements: font, font size, color codes (Pantone or CMYK values), layout, and required legal statements

blocks.zh: 物理規格： 尺寸（長 × 寬 ± 公差）、材質（紙材、膠膜種類）、黏膠規格
blocks.en: Physical specifications: dimensions (length × width ± tolerance), material (paper stock, type of film), and adhesive specification

blocks.zh: 印刷品質： 條碼可讀性（Grade B 以上）、清晰度標準、無滲墨、無色偏
blocks.en: Print quality: bar code readability (Grade B or better), clarity standards, no ink bleeding, no color deviation

blocks.zh: 合規聲明： 符合 21 CFR Part 201 的標籤要求，與核准的 NDA/ANDA/BLA 標籤版本一致
blocks.en: Compliance statements: conformity with the labeling requirements of 21 CFR Part 201 and consistency with the approved NDA/ANDA/BLA labeling version

blocks.zh: 483 常見缺失 Common 483 Observations
blocks.en: Common 483 Observations

blocks.zh: ★ 取樣代表性不足： 收料只抽取一箱外箱，未依 AQL 取樣計畫對整批標籤進行代表性取樣；或取樣未記錄抽樣位置和數量。
blocks.en: ★ Unrepresentative sampling: Only one outer carton was sampled at receipt, with no representative sampling of the whole label lot under an AQL sampling plan; or the sampling location and quantity were not recorded.

blocks.zh: ★ 過期標籤未銷毀： §211.122(e) 要求過期/廢棄標籤應予銷毀，但查廠時發現倉庫仍保有已停產規格的舊版標籤，或舊版標籤未依程序銷毀且無記錄。
blocks.en: ★ Obsolete labels not destroyed: §211.122(e) requires that obsolete or outdated labels be destroyed, but the inspection found old-version labels for a discontinued strength still held in the warehouse, or old-version labels that were not destroyed per procedure and without records.

blocks.zh: ★ 裁切標籤未個別識別： §211.122(g)(2) 要求裁切標籤的容器上必須標明藥品名稱、規格、含量及批號，但查廠時發現裁切後的標籤被散放於無識別的盒中，無法確認其歸屬批次。
blocks.en: ★ Cut labels not individually identified: §211.122(g)(2) requires that containers of cut labels be identified with the drug product name, strength, dosage form and lot number, but the inspection found cut labels loose in an unidentified box, so the lot they belonged to could not be confirmed.

blocks.zh: ★ 儲存區進出管制不足： 標籤儲存區未有效限制只有授權人員進入——無門鎖或門鎖未使用，未建立進出記錄。
blocks.en: ★ Inadequate access control to the storage area: The label storage area was not effectively restricted to authorized personnel: the door had no lock or the lock was not used, and no access log was kept.

blocks.zh: CDMO 多客戶標籤管控設計
blocks.en: Label Control Design for CDMOs Serving Multiple Clients

blocks.zh: CDMO 同時承接多家客戶的充填與包裝業務，§211.122 的實務落地尤為關鍵：
blocks.en: A CDMO takes on filling and packaging for many clients at the same time, so putting §211.122 into practice is especially critical:

blocks.zh: 分區儲存： 每位客戶的標籤儲存於獨立的有鎖儲存格（cage 或 dedicated cabinet），由品管部門保管鑰匙，非授權人員無法進入。不同客戶的標籤不得混放於同一儲存格。
blocks.en: Segregated storage: Each client's labels are stored in a separate locked compartment (cage or dedicated cabinet), with the keys held by the quality unit so that unauthorized personnel cannot enter. Labels of different clients must not be stored together in the same compartment.

blocks.zh: 版本管理： 每次客戶更新標籤設計時，舊版標籤必須全數銷毀並記錄銷毀數量，新版入庫後重新執行完整收料審查程序（含對照核准版本的視覺確認）。
blocks.en: Version management: Whenever a client updates its label design, all old-version labels must be destroyed and the quantity destroyed recorded. After the new version is received into stock, the full receipt examination procedure is repeated (including visual confirmation against the approved version).

blocks.zh: 自動化核對系統： 先進 CDMO 使用相機視覺系統（camera vision system）在線上 100% 核對標籤內容，可偵測 SKU 代碼、批號格式、條碼、有效期格式等，大幅降低人工核對的錯誤率，同時滿足 §211.125(f) 的 100% 檢查免調和要求。
blocks.en: Automated verification systems: Advanced CDMOs use camera vision systems to verify label content 100% in-line, detecting SKU codes, lot number format, bar codes, and expiration date format. This greatly reduces the error rate of manual checking and also satisfies the §211.125(f) provision that 100% examination exempts the line from reconciliation.

blocks.zh: 混淆風險評估： 對外觀相近的客戶標籤（類似字體、相近尺寸、相同顏色系），應進行標籤混淆風險評估（Label Mix-up Risk Assessment），設計額外防護措施如警告標示或顏色識別碼。
blocks.en: Mix-up risk assessment: For client labels that look alike (similar fonts, similar sizes, the same color scheme), perform a Label Mix-up Risk Assessment and design additional safeguards such as warning markings or color identification codes.

blocks.zh: 標籤物料規格（Label Specification）審查的實際執行流程
blocks.en: How Label Material Specification Review Works in Practice

blocks.zh: 以一家接受新客戶委託的 CDMO 為例，§211.122 合規的實際操作流程如下：
blocks.en: Take a CDMO that accepts a new client as an example. A practical §211.122-compliant workflow is as follows:

blocks.zh: 規格建立： 客戶提供核准版本的標籤 artwork（PDF、AI 或 EPS 格式），CDMO 的 QA 和包裝工程師共同建立「標籤物料規格書（Label Material Specification）」，涵蓋視覺要求、尺寸公差、條碼規格、印刷品質標準。此規格書需客戶 QA 書面核准後方可生效。
blocks.en: Specification set-up: The client supplies the approved label artwork (PDF, AI, or EPS format), and the CDMO's QA and packaging engineers jointly prepare the Label Material Specification, covering visual requirements, dimensional tolerances, bar code specifications, and print quality standards. The specification takes effect only after written approval by the client's QA.

blocks.zh: 供應商資格： 標籤印刷廠需通過 CDMO 的供應商資格評估（Supplier Qualification），確認其印刷品質管制系統符合要求。
blocks.en: Supplier qualification: The label printer must pass the CDMO's supplier qualification assessment, confirming that its print quality control system meets requirements.

blocks.zh: 首批收料確認： 首次收到新標籤時，QA 執行加強版收料審查（Enhanced Incoming Inspection）——100% 核對首批標籤與核准 artwork 的視覺一致性，確認後作為後續收料的「參考標準樣本（Reference Standard Sample）」封存。
blocks.en: First-lot receipt confirmation: When new labels are first received, QA performs an Enhanced Incoming Inspection: 100% of the first lot is visually checked against the approved artwork, and once confirmed, a sample is retained as the Reference Standard Sample for subsequent receipts.

blocks.zh: 常規收料： 後續批次依取樣計畫收料，以封存的參考標準樣本作為比對基準，任何偏差立即拒收並通知供應商。
blocks.en: Routine receipt: Later lots are received according to the sampling plan, using the retained reference standard sample as the comparison basis. Any deviation leads to immediate rejection and notification of the supplier.

blocks.zh: 4.2 §211.125 — Labeling Issuance（標籤發放管制）
blocks.en: 4.2 §211.125 — Labeling Issuance

blocks.zh: 標籤調和（Label Reconciliation）的核心意義
blocks.en: The Core Purpose of Label Reconciliation

blocks.zh: Label reconciliation（標籤調和）是核算「發出去幾張標籤」等於「用掉幾張 + 退回幾張 + 銷毀幾張」的機制。這個機制的目的不是節省標籤，而是確保沒有任何標籤「不明消失」——因為任何不明消失的標籤都可能被貼在了錯誤的產品上，或遺失在廠內某處，成為潛在的混淆風險。
blocks.en: Label reconciliation is the mechanism that checks that the number of labels issued equals the number used plus the number returned plus the number destroyed. Its purpose is not to save labels but to ensure that no label disappears unaccounted for, because any unexplained missing label may have been affixed to the wrong product or lost somewhere in the facility, becoming a potential mix-up risk.

blocks.zh: §211.125(f) 的免除條款：只有在執行 100% 在線檢查（100 percent examination）的情況下，才能豁免標籤調和要求。這意味著：若沒有 100% 自動化或視覺核對系統，就必須進行完整的標籤調和，任何差異都必須啟動偏差調查（deviation investigation）。
blocks.en: The exemption in §211.125(f): reconciliation may be waived only where a 100 percent examination is performed. This means that without a 100% automated or visual verification system, full label reconciliation must be performed, and any discrepancy must trigger a deviation investigation.

blocks.zh: 與電子批次記錄（eBR）和 21 CFR Part 11 的整合
blocks.en: Integration with Electronic Batch Records (eBR) and 21 CFR Part 11

blocks.zh: 傳統紙本批次記錄中，標籤調和是手動計算的——操作人員點數、記錄、計算差異。現代製造廠越來越多採用電子批次記錄（Electronic Batch Records, eBR），結合倉儲管理系統（WMS）和貼標機計數器，自動完成標籤調和。
blocks.en: In traditional paper batch records, label reconciliation is calculated by hand: operators count, record, and calculate the variance. Modern manufacturers increasingly adopt Electronic Batch Records (eBR), combined with a warehouse management system (WMS) and labeling machine counters, to perform label reconciliation automatically.

blocks.zh: 當 eBR 系統執行此功能時，整個系統必須符合 21 CFR Part 11（電子記錄與電子簽名）的要求：
blocks.en: When an eBR system performs this function, the whole system must comply with 21 CFR Part 11 (electronic records and electronic signatures):

blocks.zh: 稽核軌跡（Audit Trail）： 所有標籤發放和調和操作的時間戳記和用戶記錄不可刪除或修改
blocks.en: Audit Trail: The time stamps and user records of all label issuance and reconciliation actions cannot be deleted or modified

blocks.zh: 存取控制（Access Control）： 發放標籤和確認調和的功能僅授予特定角色
blocks.en: Access Control: The functions for issuing labels and confirming reconciliation are granted only to specific roles

blocks.zh: 電子簽名（Electronic Signature）： 發放人、操作人、QA 複核人各自以電子簽名確認，法律效力等同手寫簽名
blocks.en: Electronic Signature: The issuer, the operator, and the QA reviewer each confirm with their own electronic signature, which has the same legal effect as a handwritten signature

blocks.zh: 系統驗證（Computer System Validation, CSV）： eBR 系統本身必須經過完整驗證（IQ/OQ/PQ），確保計算邏輯正確
blocks.en: Computer System Validation (CSV): The eBR system itself must be fully validated (IQ/OQ/PQ) to ensure the calculation logic is correct

blocks.zh: 標籤發放的雙重把關原則
blocks.en: The Two-Gate Principle for Label Issuance

blocks.zh: ★ §211.125(b) 規定標籤只能由授權人員向生產人員發放。實務上，許多製造廠要求標籤發放須有 QA 人員或有書面授權的倉管人員簽核，生產人員不得自行至標籤倉庫取用標籤。
blocks.en: ★ §211.125(b) provides that labeling may be issued to production personnel only by authorized personnel. In practice, many manufacturers require that label issuance be signed off by QA or by warehouse staff with written authorization, and production personnel may not go to the label warehouse and take labels themselves.

blocks.zh: ★ §211.125(g) 明確規定：帶有批號的剩餘標籤（excess labeling）必須銷毀，而非退回庫存留待下次使用。這是防止「A批標籤混入B批」的關鍵管控——帶有舊批號的剩餘標籤絕對不能再次流入生產。銷毀方式（撕毀、切碎或焚燒）及銷毀記錄均須有書面程序規範。
blocks.en: ★ §211.125(g) states explicitly that excess labeling bearing lot or control numbers must be destroyed, not returned to stock for later use. This is the key control that prevents labels of lot A from ending up on lot B: excess labels bearing an old lot number must never re-enter production. The method of destruction (tearing, shredding, or incineration) and the destruction records must both be defined in written procedures.

blocks.zh: ★ §211.125(c) 要求每種標籤都有書面核准規格——這是與 §211.122(b) 的呼應：入庫審查依規格，發放確認也依規格。規格必須是已核准的最新版本。
blocks.en: ★ §211.125(c) requires an approved written specification for each label. This echoes §211.122(b): receipt examination is performed against the specification, and issuance is confirmed against the specification too. The specification must be the latest approved version.

blocks.zh: 標籤發放記錄（Label Issuance Log）設計要點
blocks.en: Design Points for the Label Issuance Log

blocks.zh: 一份合規的標籤發放記錄應包含以下欄位：
blocks.en: A compliant label issuance log should include the following fields:

blocks.zh: 標籤名稱、物料編號、版本號（確認使用正確版本）
blocks.en: Label name, material number, and version number (to confirm the correct version is used)

blocks.zh: 對應批次號（Batch/Lot Number）及藥品名稱、規格
blocks.en: Corresponding batch/lot number, drug product name, and strength

blocks.zh: 發放數量（Issued qty）— 含卷標每卷/每箱數量計算
blocks.en: Issued quantity, including the per-roll or per-carton quantity calculation for roll labels

blocks.zh: 使用數量（Used qty）— 來自貼標機計數器或人工點數
blocks.en: Used quantity, taken from the labeling machine counter or a manual count

blocks.zh: 退回數量（Returned qty）— 未使用的完整標籤（未帶批號的可退回）
blocks.en: Returned quantity: complete unused labels (only labels not bearing a lot number may be returned)

blocks.zh: 銷毀數量（Destroyed qty）— 帶批號的剩餘標籤，附銷毀見證簽名
blocks.en: Destroyed quantity: excess labels bearing a lot number, with the signature of the person witnessing destruction

blocks.zh: 差異（Variance）及差異說明（差異 > 可接受限度時需附偏差報告編號）
blocks.en: Variance and explanation (where the variance exceeds the acceptable limit, the deviation report number must be attached)

blocks.zh: 發放人簽名/電子簽名 + 接收人（生產操作員）確認 + QA 複核簽名
blocks.en: Issuer's signature/electronic signature, receiver (production operator) confirmation, and QA review signature

blocks.zh: 標籤發放的「可接受差異限度」設定邏輯
blocks.en: The Logic for Setting an Acceptable Label Variance Limit

blocks.zh: 調和差異（reconciliation variance）不一定意味著標籤被錯誤使用——貼標過程中因設備卡紙、測試走標、設定確認等因素確實會有少量標籤損耗。因此，製造廠通常設定一個可接受差異限度（Acceptable Variance Limit），超出此限度才觸發正式偏差調查。
blocks.en: A reconciliation variance does not necessarily mean labels were used incorrectly. A small number of labels are genuinely lost during labeling to machine jams, test runs, and set-up checks. Manufacturers therefore usually set an Acceptable Variance Limit, and a formal deviation investigation is triggered only when it is exceeded.

blocks.zh: 可接受差異限度的設定方式：
blocks.en: Ways to set the acceptable variance limit:

blocks.zh: 基於歷史數據： 分析過去 12–24 個月的標籤調和數據，計算正常損耗的平均值和標準差，以均值 ± 3σ 作為限度範圍
blocks.en: Based on historical data: Analyze label reconciliation data from the past 12–24 months, calculate the mean and standard deviation of normal losses, and use the mean ± 3σ as the limit range

blocks.zh: 依設備特性設定： 自動化高速貼標機的損耗率通常低於半自動設備——不同生產線的限度可能不同，需分別建立
blocks.en: Based on equipment characteristics: Automated high-speed labeling machines usually have lower loss rates than semi-automatic equipment, so limits may differ between lines and must be established separately

blocks.zh: 不得設定過寬： FDA 會審查可接受限度是否合理，過寬的限度（如 ±10%）可能被認為無法有效偵測標籤混淆事件
blocks.en: Do not set limits too wide: FDA will review whether the acceptable limit is reasonable; an overly wide limit (such as ±10%) may be judged unable to detect label mix-up events effectively

blocks.zh: 任何負差異（使用量 > 發放量）均為零容忍： 如果使用量超過發放量，理論上是不可能的，但若記錄顯示此情況，必定有記錄錯誤或更嚴重的問題，需立即調查
blocks.en: Any negative variance (quantity used > quantity issued) has zero tolerance: Usage exceeding issuance should be impossible in theory; if the records show it, there must be a recording error or a more serious problem, and it must be investigated immediately

blocks.zh: 4.3 §211.130 — Packaging and Labeling Operations（包裝與標籤操作管制）
blocks.en: 4.3 §211.130 — Packaging and Labeling Operations

blocks.zh: 線清（Line Clearance）：最重要的防混淆關口
blocks.en: Line Clearance: The Most Important Anti-Mix-Up Gate

blocks.zh: Line clearance（線清/換線清場）是每次批次開始前的強制性合規關口。操作人員和 QA 必須聯合確認：上一個批次的所有產品、標籤、包材、文件已全部移除或適當處置，不會遺留在生產線上造成混淆。
blocks.en: Line clearance is a mandatory compliance gate before the start of every batch. The operator and QA must jointly confirm that all product, labels, packaging materials, and documents from the previous batch have been removed or properly disposed of, and cannot remain on the line and cause a mix-up.

blocks.zh: 線清失敗是 FDA 483 觀察的常客。典型缺失包括：前批次的產品遺留在傳送帶上、前批次的標籤黏附在設備角落或標籤機料軸夾具上、前批次的批次記錄文件混在新批次資料夾中、空盒/廢料容器未清空。任何一項都可能觸發生產中止和偏差調查，嚴重者可能導致整批產品報廢。
blocks.en: Line clearance failures are frequent flyers in FDA 483 observations. Typical deficiencies include: product from the previous batch left on the conveyor, labels from the previous batch stuck in corners of the equipment or in the label reel clamps, previous-batch record documents mixed into the new batch folder, and empty cartons or waste containers not emptied. Any one of these can trigger a production stop and a deviation investigation, and in serious cases the entire batch may be scrapped.

blocks.zh: 線清 SOP 的四大設計原則
blocks.en: Four Design Principles for a Line Clearance SOP

blocks.zh: 清場核查清單（Line Clearance Checklist）： 逐項列出需清除/確認的項目（設備各面、傳送帶、標籤機料軸、設備上方架台、廢料容器、地板近設備處等），必須涵蓋所有可能遺留物品的隱蔽角落，不得遺漏。
blocks.en: Line Clearance Checklist: Itemize the things to be cleared or confirmed (all sides of the equipment, conveyors, label reel spindles, overhead racks, waste containers, the floor near the equipment, and so on). It must cover every hidden corner where items may be left behind, with nothing omitted.

blocks.zh: 雙重確認機制（Two-Person Verification）： 操作人員執行清場後，QA 人員獨立複查（不得只看操作員記錄就簽名），兩個簽名缺一不可，且應有時間戳記。
blocks.en: Two-Person Verification: After the operator performs the clearance, QA independently rechecks (QA must not sign merely on the basis of the operator's record). Both signatures are required, and each should carry a time stamp.

blocks.zh: 批次記錄整合（BPR Integration）： 線清記錄作為批次生產記錄（BPR）的不可分割部分，留存期限依 §211.180 要求（產品有效期後至少一年，或批次放行後至少三年，以較長者為準）。
blocks.en: BPR Integration: The line clearance record is an integral part of the batch production record (BPR), and its retention period follows §211.180 (at least one year after the product's expiration date, or at least three years after batch release, whichever is longer).

blocks.zh: 失敗處置程序： 若線清發現前批次殘留，必須停止新批次操作，啟動偏差程序，評估殘留物對前批次和新批次的影響，由 QA 最終決定兩個批次的處置方向。
blocks.en: Failure handling procedure: If line clearance finds residue from the previous batch, work on the new batch must stop and the deviation procedure must be initiated. The impact of the residue on both the previous and the new batch is assessed, and QA makes the final decision on the disposition of both batches.

blocks.zh: 無菌注射劑的特殊考量：標籤操作與 CCI
blocks.en: Special Considerations for Sterile Injectables: Labeling Operations and CCI

blocks.zh: 對無菌注射劑（sterile injectables）而言，§211.130 的標籤操作規範與容器密封完整性（Container Closure Integrity, CCI）檢查密切相關：
blocks.en: For sterile injectables, the labeling operation requirements of §211.130 are closely tied to Container Closure Integrity (CCI) checks:

blocks.zh: 貼標前，必須確認容器已通過 CCI 測試（如燈檢、壓力測試或色水測試），不合格容器必須在標籤貼附前完全剔除。
blocks.en: Before labeling, confirm that containers have passed CCI testing (such as visual inspection, pressure testing, or dye ingress testing); nonconforming containers must be completely removed before labels are applied.

blocks.zh: 自動貼標機的機械壓力可能對脆弱的玻璃小瓶產生應力，設備驗證中必須評估貼標機對容器完整性的潛在影響，通常在 PQ（Performance Qualification）階段執行。
blocks.en: The mechanical pressure of automatic labeling machines can stress fragile glass vials, so equipment validation must evaluate the potential effect of the labeling machine on container integrity, usually during the PQ (Performance Qualification) stage.

blocks.zh: 貼標後不應遮蓋燈檢視窗，確保終端使用者在使用前仍可目視確認容器內容物。
blocks.en: After labeling, the inspection window must not be covered, so that the end user can still visually check the contents of the container before use.

blocks.zh: 常見 FDA 483：「未能執行充分的線清」
blocks.en: Common FDA 483: "Failure to perform adequate line clearance"

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠報告中的典型 483 措辭：
blocks.en: Typical 483 wording in an FDA inspection report:

blocks.zh: CAPA 設計方向：
blocks.en: CAPA design direction:

blocks.zh: 立即措施（Immediate Action）：停止受影響批次、評估是否有產品混淆風險、評估已配送批次的安全性
blocks.en: Immediate Action: stop the affected batches, assess whether there is a risk of product mix-up, and assess the safety of batches already distributed

blocks.zh: 短期 CAPA：重新修訂線清 SOP，加入攝影記錄（Photo Documentation）要求作為客觀證據
blocks.en: Short-term CAPA: revise the line clearance SOP and add a photo documentation requirement as objective evidence

blocks.zh: 長期 CAPA：引入條碼掃描驗證系統（確認線上材料批號均屬當前批次）；加強 QA 現場監督頻率；每季進行線清程序稽核（Process Walk-through Audit）
blocks.en: Long-term CAPA: introduce a bar code scanning verification system (confirming that all materials on the line belong to the current batch); increase the frequency of QA on-the-floor supervision; perform a quarterly process walk-through audit of the line clearance procedure

blocks.zh: 培訓：對全體包裝操作人員和 QA 重新培訓線清程序，並評估培訓效果（Pre/Post Assessment）
blocks.en: Training: retrain all packaging operators and QA on the line clearance procedure, and evaluate training effectiveness (pre/post assessment)

blocks.zh: 4.4 §211.132 — Tamper-Evident Packaging for OTC Human Drug Products（防竄改包裝要求）
blocks.en: 4.4 §211.132 — Tamper-Evident Packaging for OTC Human Drug Products

blocks.zh: 防竄改包裝的歷史背景——1982 芝加哥泰諾事件
blocks.en: Historical Background of Tamper-Evident Packaging: the 1982 Chicago Tylenol Murders

blocks.zh: §211.132 的誕生直接源自 1982 年的芝加哥泰諾投毒事件（Chicago Tylenol Murders）——有人將氰化物注入零售藥架上的泰諾膠囊，造成 7 人死亡。這一事件震撼了整個製藥行業，促使 FDA 在 1982 年緊急頒布防竄改包裝法規，這是美國藥品包裝監管的里程碑。
blocks.en: §211.132 was born directly out of the 1982 Chicago Tylenol Murders, in which someone injected cyanide into Tylenol capsules on retail shelves, causing 7 deaths. The incident shook the entire pharmaceutical industry and led FDA to issue emergency tamper-resistant packaging regulations in 1982, a milestone in US drug packaging regulation.

blocks.zh: 事件之後，製藥業的包裝設計從「便利消費者」轉向「安全優先」——封口條、收縮帶、氣泡封口（induction sealing）成為 OTC 藥品的標配，消費者學會「開封前先檢查包裝完整性」。
blocks.en: After the incident, pharmaceutical packaging design shifted from "consumer convenience" to "safety first": seal strips, shrink bands, and induction sealing became standard for OTC drugs, and consumers learned to "check the package is intact before opening".
Labeling Statement Requirements (§211.132(b)(1))

blocks.zh: ★ 防竄改特徵必須在標籤上有顯著聲明（prominent statement），告知消費者具體的防竄改機制。例如：「Do not use if printed seal under cap is broken or missing」或「Sealed for your protection. Do not use if inner seal is broken.」
blocks.en: ★ The tamper-evident feature must be accompanied by a prominent statement on the label that tells the consumer the specific tamper-evident mechanism. For example: "Do not use if printed seal under cap is broken or missing" or "Sealed for your protection. Do not use if inner seal is broken."

blocks.zh: ★ 此聲明本身是標籤（labeling）的一部分，因此受 §211.122–211.130 的全套標籤管控程序約束。防竄改聲明的版本必須與核准的 NDA/ANDA 標籤一致，任何措辭變更需走標籤變更申請程序。
blocks.en: ★ This statement is itself part of the labeling, so it is subject to the full set of labeling control procedures in §211.122–211.130. The version of the tamper-evident statement must match the approved NDA/ANDA labeling, and any wording change must go through the labeling change procedure.

blocks.zh: §211.134 外觀檢查與防竄改特徵的協同
blocks.en: Coordination of §211.134 Inspection with Tamper-Evident Features

blocks.zh: §211.134 要求包裝完成後的成品外觀檢查（finished product inspection），對有防竄改要求的 OTC 藥品而言，外觀檢查清單必須明確包含防竄改特徵完整性的確認項目：
blocks.en: §211.134 requires finished product inspection on completion of packaging. For OTC drugs with tamper-evident requirements, the inspection checklist must expressly include items confirming the integrity of the tamper-evident features:

blocks.zh: 感應封口鋁箔膜是否緊密貼合、無氣泡、無邊緣翹起
blocks.en: Is the induction-seal foil liner tightly bonded, with no air bubbles and no lifted edges?

blocks.zh: 收縮帶是否均勻收縮、無裂縫、無開口
blocks.en: Is the shrink band evenly shrunk, with no cracks and no openings?

blocks.zh: 膠囊封帶是否完整覆蓋兩段接縫
blocks.en: Does the capsule sealing band completely cover the seam between the two halves?

blocks.zh: 防竄改聲明是否在標籤上清晰可讀
blocks.en: Is the tamper-evident statement clearly legible on the label?

blocks.zh: 4.4b §211.134 — Drug Product Inspection During Finishing Operations（包裝完成後成品檢查）
blocks.en: 4.4b §211.134 — Drug Product Inspection During Finishing Operations

blocks.zh: §211.134 的定位：包裝線的「最後品質閘門」
blocks.en: The Role of §211.134: the "Final Quality Gate" of the Packaging Line

blocks.zh: §211.134 是整個 Subpart G 標籤管控鏈的最後確認點——在所有標籤管控程序都執行完畢之後，成品外觀檢查是確認「出廠的每個產品都有正確標籤」的最後一道防線。它的設計邏輯是「以終為始」：即使前面的管控都完美執行，成品檢查仍有其獨立存在的必要性。
blocks.en: §211.134 is the final confirmation point in the entire Subpart G labeling control chain. After all labeling control procedures have been carried out, finished product inspection is the last line of defense for confirming that "every product leaving the facility carries the correct label". Its design logic is "begin with the end in mind": even if all the earlier controls are executed perfectly, finished product inspection still needs to exist independently.

blocks.zh: 在實際查廠中，FDA 調查員常會拿取包裝區的成品樣品親自檢視——如果調查員發現標籤問題（如有效期不清晰、標籤歪斜遮蓋關鍵信息），而成品檢查記錄顯示「Pass」，則製造廠的成品檢查程序本身就會成為 483 的標的。
blocks.en: During actual inspections, FDA investigators often pick up finished product samples in the packaging area and examine them personally. If an investigator finds a labeling problem (such as an unclear expiration date, or a skewed label covering key information) while the finished product inspection record says "Pass", the manufacturer's finished product inspection procedure itself becomes the target of a 483.

blocks.zh: 「代表性樣品」的取樣時機設計
blocks.en: Designing the Sampling Timing for "Representative Samples"

blocks.zh: §211.134(b) 要求在「包裝完成後（at the completion of finishing operations）」收集代表性樣品。取樣計畫設計的最佳實踐：
blocks.en: §211.134(b) requires that representative samples be collected "at the completion of finishing operations". Best practices for designing the sampling plan:

blocks.zh: 時間點分散原則： 樣品應自批次的開始（start）、中間（middle）和結束（end）各段分別收取，不能只取最後幾個成品，以確保整批的一致性。
blocks.en: Spread across time points: Samples should be collected from each of the start, middle, and end of the batch, not just the last few finished units, to confirm consistency across the whole batch.

blocks.zh: 換卷取樣： 對使用標籤卷的自動貼標機，每次換卷（label roll change）前後各取樣，確認換卷不影響標籤正確性、對齊和打印質量。
blocks.en: Sampling at roll changes: For automatic labeling machines using label rolls, sample before and after each label roll change to confirm that the change does not affect label correctness, alignment, and print quality.

blocks.zh: 樣品數量依書面規範： 取樣數量應有書面規定（如 AQL Level II 正常取樣，或固定件數如「每批至少 10 件，每 500 件增取 1 件」），不允許操作人員主觀決定取樣數量。
blocks.en: Sample quantity per written specification: The sampling quantity should be specified in writing (for example AQL Level II normal sampling, or a fixed count such as "at least 10 units per batch, plus 1 more for every 500 units"); operators must not decide the sample quantity subjectively.

blocks.zh: 留樣與成品樣品的區分： §211.134 的成品標籤檢查用樣品與 §211.170 留樣（Retention Sample）是不同的——留樣用於未來的穩定性或調查，成品標籤檢查樣品使用後可依程序處置。
blocks.en: Distinguishing retention samples from finished product samples: The samples used for finished product label inspection under §211.134 are different from the retention samples under §211.170: retention samples are kept for future stability testing or investigations, whereas finished product label inspection samples may be disposed of per procedure after use.

blocks.zh: 自動化視覺檢查系統（Automated Vision Inspection）的合規定位
blocks.en: Compliance Positioning of Automated Vision Inspection

blocks.zh: 越來越多的高速包裝線使用自動化相機視覺系統（Camera Vision Inspection System）執行 100% 在線標籤核對，而非僅靠人工抽樣檢查。此類系統的合規考量：
blocks.en: More and more high-speed packaging lines use camera vision inspection systems to perform 100% in-line label verification, rather than relying only on manual sampling inspection. Compliance considerations for such systems:

blocks.zh: 系統必須經過完整驗證（IQ/OQ/PQ），確認其在生產速度下能可靠偵測各類標籤缺失（如文字模糊、條碼錯誤、標籤缺失或倒置）
blocks.en: The system must be fully validated (IQ/OQ/PQ) to confirm that, at production speed, it reliably detects the various label defects (such as blurred text, bar code errors, and missing or inverted labels)

blocks.zh: 系統拒絕的不合格品（Rejects）必須記錄，並有書面程序處置（通常直接進入廢料容器，不允許重新回到生產線）
blocks.en: Nonconforming items rejected by the system (rejects) must be recorded and handled under a written procedure (usually going straight into a waste container and never allowed back onto the line)

blocks.zh: 系統驗證和定期再確認（Periodic Requalification）的記錄是 FDA 查廠的重點
blocks.en: Records of system validation and periodic requalification are a focus of FDA inspections

blocks.zh: 即使有自動化視覺系統，§211.134(b) 要求的代表性樣品人工複核仍建議保留，作為系統可靠性的獨立確認
blocks.en: Even with an automated vision system, it is advisable to keep the manual check of representative samples required by §211.134(b), as an independent confirmation of system reliability

blocks.zh: 4.5 §211.137 — Expiration Dating（有效期限——最常被引用的標籤 483）
blocks.en: 4.5 §211.137 — Expiration Dating (the Most Frequently Cited Labeling 483)

blocks.zh: 有效期的法規根基：穩定性數據決定論
blocks.en: Regulatory Basis for Expiration Dating: Stability Data Determine the Date

blocks.zh: §211.137 的核心邏輯：有效期必須由穩定性測試來決定，而非由製造商自行估算。穩定性測試的法規依據是 §211.166，並與 ICH 標準緊密對接：
blocks.en: The core logic of §211.137: the expiration date must be determined by stability testing, not estimated by the manufacturer. The regulatory basis for stability testing is §211.166, and it is closely aligned with ICH standards:

blocks.zh: ICH Q1A(R2)：新原料藥及新製劑穩定性測試指引——規定測試條件（溫度/濕度）、測試時間點、最低批次數（通常 3 批以上）
blocks.en: ICH Q1A(R2): guideline on stability testing of new drug substances and products. It specifies the test conditions (temperature/humidity), time points, and the minimum number of batches (usually three or more)

blocks.zh: ICH Q1E：穩定性數據評估（外推法）——允許在實時數據不完整時，利用統計方法（線性回歸）外推有效期，但有條件限制
blocks.en: ICH Q1E: evaluation of stability data (extrapolation). It allows the shelf life to be extrapolated by statistical methods (linear regression) when real-time data are incomplete, subject to conditions

blocks.zh: ICH Q1B：光穩定性測試——光敏感製劑的有效期需涵蓋光降解測試
blocks.en: ICH Q1B: photostability testing. The shelf life of light-sensitive products must take photodegradation testing into account

blocks.zh: 兩條穩定性路徑：
blocks.en: Two stability pathways:

blocks.zh: Real-time stability（實時穩定性）： 在預期儲存條件（如 25°C/60% RH 或 5°C 冷藏）下長期監測。這是有效期的唯一確定性依據，最終有效期必須有實時數據支持。
blocks.en: Real-time stability: Long-term monitoring under the intended storage conditions (such as 25°C/60% RH, or 5°C refrigerated). This is the only definitive basis for the expiration date, and the final shelf life must be supported by real-time data.

blocks.zh: Accelerated stability（加速穩定性）： 在加速條件（如 40°C/75% RH）下短期測試，可支持初始有效期設定（interim shelf life），但必須有持續的實時穩定性數據跟進確認。
blocks.en: Accelerated stability: Short-term testing under accelerated conditions (such as 40°C/75% RH). It can support setting an interim shelf life, but must be followed up and confirmed by ongoing real-time stability data.

blocks.zh: 超量配方（Overage）與有效期的關係
blocks.en: The Relationship Between Overage and Expiration Dating

blocks.zh: Overage（超量）是指在配方中加入超出標示量的活性成分，補償製造或儲存過程中的降解損失，確保產品在有效期末（End of Shelf Life, EoSL）仍符合標示含量規格。例如：標示 100 mg/tablet，配方投入 105 mg，確保 24 個月後含量仍 ≥95%。
blocks.en: Overage means adding active ingredient in excess of the labeled amount to the formulation, to compensate for degradation losses during manufacturing or storage so that the product still meets the labeled content specification at End of Shelf Life (EoSL). For example: for a label claim of 100 mg/tablet, the formulation is charged at 105 mg to ensure the content is still ≥95% after 24 months.

blocks.zh: FDA 對 Overage 的立場：
blocks.en: FDA's position on overage:

blocks.zh: Overage 必須有穩定性數據支持，說明降解速率合理且 overage 量足以補償
blocks.en: Overage must be supported by stability data showing that the degradation rate is reasonable and that the overage amount is sufficient to compensate for it

blocks.zh: 不能以增加 overage 代替充分的穩定性研究來延長有效期
blocks.en: Increasing overage cannot substitute for adequate stability studies as a way to extend the shelf life

blocks.zh: 超量比例過大（通常 >10%）需有充分科學理由，避免患者在產品有效期初期攝入過量活性成分
blocks.en: An overage that is too large (usually >10%) needs adequate scientific justification, to avoid patients receiving an excess of active ingredient early in the shelf life

blocks.zh: Overage 的使用必須在 NDA/ANDA 中申報核准，不能在未申報的情況下自行調整
blocks.en: The use of overage must be declared and approved in the NDA/ANDA and cannot be adjusted on the manufacturer's own initiative without a filing

blocks.zh: 最常被引用的 483 觀察：有效期未獲穩定性數據支持
blocks.en: The Most Frequently Cited 483 Observation: Expiration Dating Not Supported by Stability Data

blocks.zh: 典型 483 措辭：
blocks.en: Typical 483 wording:

blocks.zh: 常見根本原因：
blocks.en: Common root causes:

blocks.zh: 穩定性計畫設計不完整，未涵蓋所有規格、包材或儲存條件
blocks.en: The stability program is incompletely designed and does not cover all strengths, packaging materials, or storage conditions

blocks.zh: 穩定性樣品在某個時間點出現 OOS 結果，但未依 §211.192 調查或縮短有效期
blocks.en: A stability sample gave an OOS result at some time point, but it was not investigated under §211.192 and the expiration date was not shortened

blocks.zh: 製劑或包材變更後未重新進行穩定性研究（Post-Change Stability Study）
blocks.en: No stability study was repeated after a change in formulation or packaging material (post-change stability study)

blocks.zh: 計算有效期的起始點（製造日 vs. 充填日 vs. 放行日）未有書面規範，各批次起算點不一致
blocks.en: The starting point for calculating the expiration date (manufacturing date vs. filling date vs. release date) is not defined in writing, so different batches use different starting points

blocks.zh: CDMO 的有效期責任歸屬——品質協議關鍵條款
blocks.en: CDMO Responsibility for Expiration Dating: Key Quality Agreement Clauses

blocks.zh: ★ 即使穩定性數據由客戶（NDA/ANDA 持有人）提供，負責製造和充填的 CDMO 對標籤上印刷的有效期的正確性，在 21 CFR 211 框架下仍承擔 CGMP 責任。
blocks.en: ★ Even when the stability data are supplied by the client (the NDA/ANDA holder), the CDMO that manufactures and fills the product still bears CGMP responsibility under 21 CFR 211 for the correctness of the expiration date printed on the label.

blocks.zh: ★ 品質協議（Quality Agreement）中應明確以下責任分工：
blocks.en: ★ The Quality Agreement should clearly define the following division of responsibilities:

blocks.zh: 客戶提供穩定性數據及核准的有效期計算規則（如「充填日起 24 個月」）
blocks.en: The client provides the stability data and the approved expiration date calculation rule (such as "24 months from the filling date")

blocks.zh: CDMO 根據客戶提供的規則計算每批批次的有效期，計算結果在批次記錄中記錄並有 QA 複核
blocks.en: The CDMO calculates the expiration date of each batch according to the rule provided by the client, and the result is recorded in the batch record and reviewed by QA

blocks.zh: 有效期計算的書面規則（含起算日定義、格式要求）必須經客戶 QA 書面核准後才可執行
blocks.en: The written rule for calculating the expiration date (including the definition of the starting date and format requirements) must be approved in writing by the client's QA before it is implemented

blocks.zh: 若客戶穩定性數據發生變更（如縮短有效期），客戶必須即時通知 CDMO 並更新品質協議附件
blocks.en: If the client's stability data change (for example, the shelf life is shortened), the client must notify the CDMO immediately and update the Quality Agreement appendix

blocks.zh: 完整穩定性計畫的設計要點
blocks.en: Design Points for a Complete Stability Program

blocks.zh: 一個滿足 §211.137 + §211.166 + ICH Q1A 要求的穩定性計畫應包含：
blocks.en: A stability program that meets the requirements of §211.137 + §211.166 + ICH Q1A should include:

blocks.zh: 儲存條件： 長期（25°C/60% RH 或 5°C）+ 加速（40°C/75% RH）± 中間條件（30°C/65% RH）
blocks.en: Storage conditions: long-term (25°C/60% RH or 5°C) + accelerated (40°C/75% RH) ± intermediate (30°C/65% RH)

blocks.zh: 批次代表性： 至少三批 Pilot Scale 以上批次，涵蓋代表性的生產和包材批次
blocks.en: Batch representativeness: at least three batches of pilot scale or larger, covering representative production and packaging material lots

blocks.zh: 測試時間點： 0、3、6、9、12、18、24、36 月（依目標有效期），ICH Q1A 規定的最低時間點不得遺漏
blocks.en: Test time points: 0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 18, 24, 36 months (depending on the target shelf life); the minimum time points specified in ICH Q1A must not be omitted

blocks.zh: 穩定性指示測試（Stability-Indicating Assay）： 含量 + 降解產物（HPLC）+ 外觀 + 物理特性（pH、溶出度、不溶性微粒等）
blocks.en: Stability-Indicating Assay: assay + degradation products (HPLC) + appearance + physical properties (pH, dissolution, subvisible particulates, and so on)

blocks.zh: 包材一致性： 穩定性批次必須使用與商業化生產完全相同的容器-密封系統（container-closure system）
blocks.en: Packaging consistency: stability batches must use exactly the same container-closure system as commercial production

blocks.zh: 年度持續穩定性（Annual Stability）： 每年至少一批商業化批次納入持續穩定性監測，確保有效期在整個產品生命週期中持續獲得支持
blocks.en: Annual Stability: at least one commercial batch per year is placed on the ongoing stability program, so that the shelf life remains supported throughout the product lifecycle

blocks.zh: 有效期格式的實務規範（§201.17）
blocks.en: Practical Rules for Expiration Date Format (§201.17)

blocks.zh: §201.17 對有效期標示格式有具體要求，以下是常見的合規與不合規格式示例：
blocks.en: §201.17 sets specific requirements for the format of the expiration date. The following are examples of common compliant and noncompliant formats:

blocks.zh: 重要原則：有效期格式必須清晰、明確且不易誤讀，且在標籤上顯著可見（prominent and conspicuous）——不得使用與背景過近的顏色、過小的字體或不易辨讀的位置。
blocks.en: Key principle: the expiration date format must be clear, unambiguous and hard to misread, and must be prominent and conspicuous on the label. Do not use a color too close to the background, a font that is too small, or a hard-to-read location.

blocks.zh: 4.6 §211.142 — Warehousing Procedures（倉儲程序）
blocks.en: 4.6 §211.142 — Warehousing Procedures

blocks.zh: 倉儲管制的四個核心維度
blocks.en: Four Core Dimensions of Warehouse Control

blocks.zh: §211.142 的文字雖簡潔，但實務要求涵蓋相當廣泛：
blocks.en: The text of §211.142 is brief, but the practical requirements are quite broad:

blocks.zh: 溫度管控（Temperature）： 冷藏（2–8°C）、冷凍（-20°C 或 -80°C）、受控室溫（CRT, 15–30°C）等不同儲存條件需有獨立儲存區域和連續溫度監測記錄（連續記錄器或具稽核軌跡的數據記錄儀）。
blocks.en: Temperature: Different storage conditions such as refrigerated (2–8°C), frozen (-20°C or -80°C), and controlled room temperature (CRT, 15–30°C) need separate storage areas and continuous temperature monitoring records (continuous recorders or data loggers with audit trails).

blocks.zh: 隔離管控（Quarantine Segregation）： 未放行產品（quarantine）與已放行產品必須物理分隔，或透過電子倉管系統（WMS）電子隔離——系統須有防止操作人員在無 QA 授權情況下調整隔離狀態的存取控制。
blocks.en: Quarantine segregation: Unreleased (quarantine) product and released product must be physically separated, or electronically segregated through a warehouse management system (WMS). The system must have access controls that prevent operators from changing the quarantine status without QA authorization.

blocks.zh: 光線管控（Light）： 光敏感藥品（某些抗生素、某些生物製品）需遮光儲存，倉庫照明設計或包材設計需滿足此要求。
blocks.en: Light: Light-sensitive drugs (some antibiotics, some biologics) must be stored protected from light, and the warehouse lighting design or the packaging design must meet this requirement.

blocks.zh: 濕度管控（Humidity）： 對吸濕性藥品（如某些凍乾製劑、泡騰劑）或帶乾燥劑的包裝系統，倉庫相對濕度管控至關重要，須有書面限度和監測記錄。
blocks.en: Humidity: For hygroscopic products (such as some lyophilized products and effervescent products) or packaging systems with desiccant, warehouse relative humidity control is critical, with written limits and monitoring records.

blocks.zh: 溫度偏差（Temperature Excursion）管理程序
blocks.en: Temperature Excursion Management Procedure

blocks.zh: 溫度偏差是倉儲最常見的 GMP 挑戰，一個完整的溫度偏差管理程序應包含：
blocks.en: Temperature excursions are the most common GMP challenge in warehousing. A complete temperature excursion management procedure should include:

blocks.zh: 預警設定（Alert vs. Action Limits）： 預警限度（Alert）比規格限度保守，提早觸發調查。例如：儲存規格 2–8°C，Alert 設 3–7°C，Action（動作限度）設 2–8°C。
blocks.en: Alert vs. Action Limits: The alert limit is tighter than the specification limit so that investigation is triggered early. For example, with a 2–8°C storage specification, set the alert limit at 3–7°C and the action limit at 2–8°C.

blocks.zh: 即時警報系統： 溫度超出 Alert 即自動通知值班人員（電話、簡訊或 SCADA 系統報警），不依賴人員定時巡視。
blocks.en: Real-time alarm system: When the temperature goes outside the alert limit, on-duty staff are notified automatically (by phone, text message, or a SCADA alarm), without relying on periodic rounds by personnel.

blocks.zh: 偏差分類評估（Impact Assessment）： 依偏差幅度和持續時間分類——微小偏差（如 +0.5°C 持續 15 分鐘）可能只需記錄；重大偏差（如 12°C 持續 4 小時）需啟動正式偏差調查，評估對產品穩定性的影響。
blocks.en: Impact Assessment by deviation category: Classify by magnitude and duration. A minor excursion (such as +0.5°C for 15 minutes) may only need to be recorded; a major excursion (such as 12°C for 4 hours) requires a formal deviation investigation to assess the effect on product stability.

blocks.zh: 平均動力學溫度（Mean Kinetic Temperature, MKT）： 偏差期間的溫度-時間數據計算 MKT，與穩定性研究條件比較，評估產品是否仍在可接受的溫度暴露範圍內。USP <1079> 提供 MKT 的計算公式。
blocks.en: Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT): Calculate the MKT from the temperature-time data during the excursion and compare it with the stability study conditions to assess whether the product is still within an acceptable range of temperature exposure. USP <1079> provides the MKT calculation formula.

blocks.zh: 產品處置決定： QA 基於評估結果決定批次可否放行、需再測試、降級使用或銷毀，並由 QA 主管書面簽核。
blocks.en: Product disposition decision: Based on the assessment, QA decides whether the batch can be released, needs retesting, can be used with downgraded status, or must be destroyed, with written sign-off by the QA head.

blocks.zh: 溫控腔體驗證（Temperature Mapping）
blocks.en: Temperature Mapping of Temperature-Controlled Chambers

blocks.zh: 根據 USP <1079>（Good Storage and Distribution Practices for Drug Products）和 WHO 指引，倉庫冷藏設備必須進行溫度製圖驗證（Temperature Mapping），確認設備內部各點均符合儲存規格。關鍵評估要素：
blocks.en: According to USP <1079> (Good Storage and Distribution Practices for Drug Products) and WHO guidance, warehouse refrigeration equipment must undergo temperature mapping to confirm that every point inside the equipment meets the storage specification. Key elements of the evaluation:

blocks.zh: 熱點/冷點（Hot/Cold Spot）識別： 均勻分佈感測器（建議至少 9 點），找出最高溫和最低溫位置，作為日常監測感測器的安裝位置
blocks.en: Hot/Cold Spot identification: Distribute sensors evenly (at least 9 points recommended) to find the highest and lowest temperature locations, which then become the installation positions for routine monitoring sensors

blocks.zh: 門開啟恢復時間（Door Open Recovery Time）： 模擬正常使用中的開門操作，確認設備能在可接受時間內恢復至規格範圍
blocks.en: Door Open Recovery Time: Simulate door opening during normal use to confirm that the equipment returns to within the specification range in an acceptable time

blocks.zh: 斷電後保溫時間（Power Failure Hold Time）： 評估斷電後設備能維持規格溫度多長時間（對確定緊急處置的時間窗口至關重要）
blocks.en: Power Failure Hold Time: Evaluate how long the equipment can hold the specified temperature after a power failure (essential for defining the time window for emergency response)

blocks.zh: 季節性再驗證： 夏季（環境溫度最高）和冬季（環境溫度最低）條件下各執行一次，因環境溫度顯著影響設備效能
blocks.en: Seasonal requalification: Perform mapping once in summer (highest ambient temperature) and once in winter (lowest ambient temperature), because ambient temperature significantly affects equipment performance

blocks.zh: 483 常見倉儲缺失
blocks.en: Common 483 Warehousing Deficiencies

blocks.zh: ★ 溫度記錄中斷未調查： 溫度記錄系統顯示有數小時的記錄缺口（logger 斷電或感測器故障），但沒有偏差報告記錄此中斷期間的溫度狀況或影響評估。
blocks.en: ★ Interruption of temperature records not investigated: The temperature recording system shows a gap of several hours (logger power loss or sensor failure), but no deviation report documents the temperature conditions or the impact assessment for that interruption.

blocks.zh: ★ 隔離狀態不明確： 倉庫中未放行和已放行產品只靠紙質標籤區分，沒有物理屏障或 WMS 電子管控，存在人員搬運混淆風險。
blocks.en: ★ Unclear quarantine status: Unreleased and released product in the warehouse are distinguished only by paper labels, with no physical barrier or WMS electronic control, so there is a risk of mix-up during handling.

blocks.zh: ★ 監測設備超出校正期： 倉庫溫度感測器或數據記錄儀的校正有效期已過，但仍在使用且未標示校正狀態。
blocks.en: ★ Monitoring equipment out of calibration: The calibration due date of the warehouse temperature sensor or data logger has passed, yet it is still in use and its calibration status is not indicated.

blocks.zh: 4.7 §211.150 — Distribution Procedures（配送程序與召回追溯）
blocks.en: 4.7 §211.150 — Distribution Procedures

blocks.zh: FIFO vs. FEFO：先進先出 vs. 近效期先出
blocks.en: FIFO vs. FEFO: First-In, First-Out vs. First-Expired, First-Out

blocks.zh: FIFO（First-In, First-Out，先進先出）是 §211.150(a)(1) 明文要求的庫存輪換原則。實務上，更進階的做法是 FEFO（First-Expired, First-Out，近效期先出）——優先配送最快到期的批次，而非純粹依生產/收料日期排序。FEFO 更能有效防止產品在批次有效期末仍滯留倉庫的情況。
blocks.en: FIFO (First-In, First-Out) is the stock rotation principle expressly required by §211.150(a)(1). In practice, a more advanced approach is FEFO (First-Expired, First-Out), which ships the batch closest to expiry first rather than ordering purely by manufacturing or receipt date. FEFO is more effective at preventing product from remaining in the warehouse at the end of a batch's shelf life.

blocks.zh: WMS（Warehouse Management System）系統落地設計：
blocks.en: Implementing this in a WMS (Warehouse Management System):

blocks.zh: 系統自動在揀貨（Pick Order）中優先指定 FIFO 或 FEFO 批次，防止操作人員手動選取不符合輪換原則的批次
blocks.en: The system automatically designates FIFO or FEFO batches first in the pick order, preventing operators from manually selecting batches that do not follow the rotation principle

blocks.zh: 任何偏離 FIFO/FEFO 的配送必須有書面理由（如客戶緊急指定批次），並由 QA 核准，記錄在配送偏差記錄中
blocks.en: Any shipment that deviates from FIFO/FEFO must have a written justification (such as a client's urgent request for a specific batch), be approved by QA, and be recorded in a distribution deviation record

blocks.zh: §211.150(a)(1) 允許「暫時且適當的例外（temporary and appropriate deviation）」——但「暫時」必須有明確時間限制，不能成為常態
blocks.en: §211.150(a)(1) allows a "temporary and appropriate deviation", but "temporary" must have a defined time limit and must not become the norm

blocks.zh: 配送記錄與 72 小時召回回應
blocks.en: Distribution Records and the 72-Hour Recall Response

blocks.zh: §211.150(a)(2) 的核心要求是：任何批次的藥品，都必須能夠快速（readily）確定其完整配送去向，以支持召回操作。
blocks.en: The core requirement of §211.150(a)(2) is that the complete distribution of any batch of drug product must be readily determinable, to support recall operations.

blocks.zh: FDA 在召回指引（21 CFR Part 7）和 RPM（Recall Policy Manual）中期望製造商能在72 小時內提供完整的配送清單（distribution list），列出所有曾接收召回批次的收貨人名稱、地址和配送數量。這對召回有效性（recall effectiveness）至關重要——FDA 會在召回結束後進行召回有效性核查（recall audit），確認所有配送的產品是否已被聯繫。
blocks.en: Under the recall regulations (21 CFR Part 7) and the Recall Policy Manual (RPM), FDA expects manufacturers to provide a complete distribution list within 72 hours, listing the name, address, and quantity shipped for every consignee that received the recalled batch. This is critical to recall effectiveness: after a recall ends, FDA performs a recall audit to confirm that all consignees of distributed product have been contacted.

blocks.zh: 現代最佳實踐：ERP/WMS 系統中，輸入批號即可立即匯出完整配送清單，不需人工逐一查找記錄。
blocks.en: Modern best practice: in the ERP/WMS system, entering a lot number immediately exports the complete distribution list, with no need to look up records one by one.

blocks.zh: GDP（良好配送規範）與 §211.150 的國際維度
blocks.en: GDP (Good Distribution Practice) and the International Dimension of §211.150

blocks.zh: Good Distribution Practice (GDP) 是 §211.150 的延伸概念，在多個國際法規框架中有完整的系統性規範：
blocks.en: Good Distribution Practice (GDP) is an extension of the concept in §211.150 and is systematically set out in several international regulatory frameworks:

blocks.zh: EU GDP Guideline（2013/C 343/01）： 歐盟最完整的 GDP 指引，適用於藥品批發商和物流商，涵蓋資格評估、溫控物流、偏差管理、客訴處理
blocks.en: EU GDP Guidelines (2013/C 343/01): The most comprehensive GDP guidance in the EU, applicable to wholesale distributors and logistics providers, covering qualification, temperature-controlled logistics, deviation management, and complaint handling

blocks.zh: WHO TRS No. 957, Annex 5（2010）： WHO 良好儲存和配送規範，廣泛被開發中國家的監管機構採用
blocks.en: WHO TRS No. 957, Annex 5 (2010): WHO good storage and distribution practices, widely adopted by regulators in developing countries

blocks.zh: USP <1079>（Good Storage and Distribution Practices）： 技術指引，提供溫控藥品的具體技術要求，包括 MKT 計算和溫控腔體驗證
blocks.en: USP <1079> (Good Storage and Distribution Practices): Technical guidance giving specific technical requirements for temperature-controlled drugs, including MKT calculation and temperature mapping

blocks.zh: IATA DGR（Dangerous Goods Regulations）： 涉及生物樣品或危險品類藥品的航空運輸適用
blocks.en: IATA DGR (Dangerous Goods Regulations): Applies to air transport of biological samples or drugs classed as dangerous goods

blocks.zh: CDMO 冷鏈物流的品質協議設計
blocks.en: Quality Agreement Design for CDMO Cold Chain Logistics

blocks.zh: 對承接冷藏/冷凍藥品業務的 CDMO，§211.150 在品質協議中的落地設計至關重要：
blocks.en: For a CDMO handling refrigerated/frozen drug products, putting §211.150 into the Quality Agreement is critical:

blocks.zh: 倉儲溫度記錄移交： CDMO 在產品移交給客戶或第三方物流商時，需提供完整的倉儲溫度記錄，確認在 CDMO 保管期間無溫度偏差，或偏差已評估閉合。
blocks.en: Handover of warehouse temperature records: When handing product over to the client or a third-party logistics provider, the CDMO must provide complete warehouse temperature records, confirming that no temperature excursion occurred during CDMO custody or that any excursion was assessed and closed.

blocks.zh: 配送記錄保存責任： 品質協議應明確：配送記錄由哪方保存（CDMO 或客戶）、保存年限（通常至少產品有效期後一年）、以及召回時的記錄提取 SLA（如 24 小時內）。
blocks.en: Responsibility for retaining distribution records: The Quality Agreement should specify which party keeps the distribution records (CDMO or client), the retention period (usually at least one year after the product's expiration date), and the SLA for retrieving records in a recall (such as within 24 hours).

blocks.zh: 承運商資格評估（GDP Qualification）： 若 CDMO 安排承運商，需對承運商進行 GDP 資格評估並記錄；若客戶自行安排物流，CDMO 的責任範圍到出廠移交點為止，品質協議中需明確移交點定義（如「貨物裝載至客戶物流商承運時」）。
blocks.en: Carrier qualification (GDP qualification): If the CDMO arranges the carrier, the carrier must undergo a documented GDP qualification assessment; if the client arranges logistics itself, the CDMO's responsibility ends at the handover point at the facility, and the Quality Agreement must define the handover point clearly (for example, "when the goods are loaded onto the client's logistics provider").

blocks.zh: 多層供應鏈追溯： 在客戶 → CDMO 充填 → 第三方倉儲 → 第三方物流 → 配銷商 → 醫院/藥局的多層鏈條中，每個節點的配送記錄必須可串聯，確保召回時能從市售批號反向追溯至每一個中間節點。
blocks.en: Multi-tier supply chain traceability: In a chain of client → CDMO filling → third-party warehouse → third-party logistics → distributor → hospital/pharmacy, the distribution records at each node must be linkable, so that in a recall it is possible to trace back from the market lot number to every intermediate node.

blocks.zh: 配送記錄設計與召回演練
blocks.en: Distribution Record Design and Recall Drills

blocks.zh: 合規的配送記錄系統設計要點：
blocks.en: Design points for a compliant distribution record system:

blocks.zh: 即時更新： 每次配送後 24 小時內完成記錄更新，不允許事後補記
blocks.en: Real-time updates: Records are updated within 24 hours of each shipment; retrospective entries are not allowed

blocks.zh: 可查詢性： 可以批號為鍵值（Key），在 10 分鐘內匯出完整配送清單（支持召回）
blocks.en: Searchability: With the lot number as the key, a complete distribution list can be exported within 10 minutes (to support a recall)

blocks.zh: 記錄完整性： 包含 §211.150(b) 的全部要求欄位，無法被刪除（符合 21 CFR Part 11 如適用）
blocks.en: Record completeness: Includes all fields required by §211.150(b), and cannot be deleted (compliant with 21 CFR Part 11 where applicable)

blocks.zh: 年度召回演練（Recall Drill）： 每年至少執行一次模擬召回演練，模擬某批號產品的配送追溯（Mock Recall），評估是否能在 72 小時內達到 100% 追溯，演練結果記錄在案並用於持續改進
blocks.en: Annual Recall Drill: Perform a simulated recall (mock recall) at least once a year, simulating distribution tracing for a given lot, to evaluate whether 100% traceability can be achieved within 72 hours; the drill results are documented and used for continual improvement

blocks.zh: §211.150 與 FDA 21 CFR Part 7 的配套義務
blocks.en: §211.150 and the Companion Obligations of FDA 21 CFR Part 7

blocks.zh: ★ 21 CFR Part 7（Enforcement Policy）規定了製造商在 FDA 要求召回時的義務，包含：(1) 在 FDA 規定時間內提交配送清單；(2) 聯繫所有直接受貨人；(3) 定期向 FDA 提交召回狀態報告；(4) 最終召回有效性評估。
blocks.en: ★ 21 CFR Part 7 (Enforcement Policy) sets out the manufacturer's obligations when FDA requests a recall, including: (1) submitting the distribution list within the time FDA specifies; (2) contacting all direct consignees; (3) submitting periodic recall status reports to FDA; and (4) the final recall effectiveness assessment.

blocks.zh: ★ §211.150 建立的配送記錄系統是履行 Part 7 召回義務的技術基礎。若配送記錄不完整或查詢困難，製造商無法在規定時間內提供配送清單，可能被 FDA 認定為妨礙召回執行，引發額外的監管關注。
blocks.en: ★ The distribution record system established under §211.150 is the technical foundation for meeting the Part 7 recall obligations. If distribution records are incomplete or hard to query, the manufacturer cannot provide the distribution list within the required time and may be viewed by FDA as obstructing the execution of the recall, inviting additional regulatory attention.

blocks.zh: ★ 特別注意：§211.150(b) 要求每批次配送記錄包含「收貨人姓名和地址」，這意味著配送到醫院、診所、藥局等終端機構的記錄需精確到機構地址層級，而非僅記錄至批發商。對於多層配銷的產品，製造商的直接記錄責任到第一個直接收貨人（即直接客戶），後續層級的追蹤責任落在批發商/配銷商各自的記錄系統。
blocks.en: ★ Special note: §211.150(b) requires each batch's distribution record to include the "name and address of the consignee", which means that records of shipments to end institutions such as hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies must be precise to the institution's address, not just recorded down to the wholesaler. For products with multi-tier distribution, the manufacturer's direct record-keeping responsibility extends to the first direct consignee (that is, the direct customer), and tracing at later tiers falls to the record systems of the wholesalers/distributors themselves.

blocks.zh: 召回類別與 §211.150 的直接連結
blocks.en: Recall Classes and Their Direct Link to §211.150

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 7 定義了召回的三個類別（Class I / II / III），標籤相關缺失幾乎清一色屬於 Class I（最嚴重）或 Class II：
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 7 defines three recall classes (Class I / II / III); labeling-related defects almost invariably fall into Class I (most serious) or Class II:

blocks.zh: §211.150(a)(2) 要求的「可隨時確定每批次配送去向」，正是為了支持上述各類召回時的快速全量追溯。FDA 在召回完成後會對召回有效性（recall effectiveness）進行核查，若製造商無法證明所有配送的產品都已被通知和/或回收，召回可能被評定為「無效（ineffective）」，觸發進一步的監管行動。
blocks.en: The requirement of §211.150(a)(2) that the distribution of each batch be "readily determinable" exists precisely to support rapid, complete tracing in all of these classes of recall. After a recall is completed, FDA verifies recall effectiveness; if the manufacturer cannot show that all distributed product has been notified and/or retrieved, the recall may be classed as "ineffective", triggering further regulatory action.

blocks.zh: 系統性合規改進策略 Systemic Compliance Improvement
blocks.en: Systemic Compliance Improvement

blocks.zh: 從「逐條合規」到「系統性標籤管控」
blocks.en: From "Clause-by-Clause Compliance" to "Systematic Label Control"

blocks.zh: 許多製造廠在 §211.122–211.137 上採取「逐條勾選」的合規策略——每一條都有對應的書面 SOP，但各程序之間缺乏整合，整體標籤管控系統仍存在漏洞。真正的合規卓越（compliance excellence）需要從系統設計出發：
blocks.en: Many manufacturers take a "box-ticking" approach to §211.122–211.137: every clause has a corresponding written SOP, but the procedures are not integrated with one another, so the overall label control system still has gaps. True compliance excellence has to start from system design:

blocks.zh: 標籤生命週期管理（Label Lifecycle Management）： 從標籤 artwork 設計核准 → 印刷廠供應商資格 → 收料審查 → 儲存 → 發放 → 使用 → 調和 → 銷毀，建立一個無斷點的管控鏈。
blocks.en: Label Lifecycle Management: Build a control chain with no breaks: label artwork design and approval → printer supplier qualification → receipt examination → storage → issuance → use → reconciliation → destruction.

blocks.zh: 風險分層管控： 基於產品風險等級（如高危藥品 HPAPI vs. 一般 OTC）設計不同強度的標籤管控措施——高風險產品需要額外的控制層（如雙重確認、相機視覺系統），低風險產品可適用更精簡的程序。
blocks.en: Risk-tiered control: Design controls of different intensity based on product risk level (for example, high-hazard HPAPI products vs. general OTC). High-risk products need extra layers of control (such as two-person verification or a camera vision system), while low-risk products can use leaner procedures.

blocks.zh: KPI 驅動的持續改進： 追蹤並定期檢視標籤管控相關 KPI，如：標籤調和差異率、線清失敗率、標籤收料拒絕率。KPI 趨勢惡化時應主動啟動 CAPA，而非等到 FDA 查廠才回應。
blocks.en: KPI-driven continual improvement: Track and regularly review label-control KPIs such as label reconciliation variance rate, line clearance failure rate, and label receipt rejection rate. When a KPI trend worsens, proactively initiate a CAPA rather than waiting for an FDA inspection to respond.

blocks.zh: 數位化轉型對 Subpart G–H 合規的影響
blocks.en: The Impact of Digital Transformation on Subpart G–H Compliance

blocks.zh: 製藥業的數位化轉型（Digital Transformation）正在重塑 Subpart G–H 的合規實踐：
blocks.en: Digital transformation in the pharmaceutical industry is reshaping compliance practice under Subpart G–H:

blocks.zh: 序列化（Serialization）與 DSCSA： 21 CFR Part 211 的標籤要求與 Drug Supply Chain Security Act（DSCSA）的序列化要求（每個銷售單位的唯一產品識別碼）緊密銜接——每個產品序列號同時是標籤要素（§211.130）和配送追溯的基本單位（§211.150）。自 2023 年起，DSCSA 的序列化和追溯要求已全面生效。
blocks.en: Serialization and DSCSA: The labeling requirements of 21 CFR Part 211 mesh closely with the serialization requirements of the Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA), which call for a unique product identifier on each saleable unit. Each product serial number is both a labeling element (§211.130) and the basic unit of distribution traceability (§211.150). Since 2023, the DSCSA serialization and traceability requirements have been fully in effect.

blocks.zh: 倉儲管理系統（WMS）整合： 現代 WMS 將隔離管控、FIFO/FEFO 輪換、配送記錄生成整合在同一平台，大幅減少人工操作錯誤，但系統驗證（CSV）成為新的合規重點。
blocks.en: Warehouse management system (WMS) integration: A modern WMS integrates quarantine control, FIFO/FEFO rotation, and distribution record generation on one platform, greatly reducing manual errors, but system validation (CSV) becomes a new compliance focus.

blocks.zh: 物聯網（IoT）溫度監測： 無線溫度感測器 + 雲端監測平台（如 Dickson、AKCP）可實現倉庫、運輸途中的實時溫度追蹤，自動生成合規記錄，大幅提升 §211.142 的合規效率——但設備驗證和數據完整性（21 CFR Part 11）是必須同步解決的議題。
blocks.en: Internet of Things (IoT) temperature monitoring: Wireless temperature sensors plus a cloud monitoring platform (such as Dickson or AKCP) enable real-time temperature tracking in the warehouse and in transit and generate compliant records automatically, greatly improving the efficiency of §211.142 compliance. However, equipment validation and data integrity (21 CFR Part 11) must be addressed at the same time.

blocks.zh: 查廠前 Subpart G–H 自查要點
blocks.en: Pre-Inspection Self-Assessment Points for Subpart G–H

blocks.zh: 在迎接 FDA 查廠前，針對 Subpart G–H 的自查清單（Pre-Inspection Self-Assessment）：
blocks.en: Pre-Inspection Self-Assessment checklist for Subpart G–H before an FDA inspection:

blocks.zh: 抽查最近 12 個月的標籤調和記錄：是否有差異？差異是否均有偏差報告和根本原因調查？
blocks.en: Spot-check label reconciliation records for the last 12 months: are there variances? Does every variance have a deviation report and root cause investigation?

blocks.zh: 確認標籤倉庫：廢棄標籤是否已全數銷毀？儲存分區是否清晰？存取記錄是否完整？
blocks.en: Check the label warehouse: have all obsolete labels been destroyed? Is the storage segregation clear? Are the access records complete?

blocks.zh: 查閱線清記錄：是否有雙重簽名？時間戳記是否在批次開始之前？
blocks.en: Review line clearance records: are there two signatures? Is the time stamp before the start of the batch?

blocks.zh: 確認穩定性計畫：所有上市規格是否均有持續穩定性批次在測試中？是否有任何時間點的 OOS 結果尚未調查閉合？
blocks.en: Check the stability program: does every marketed strength have ongoing stability batches under test? Is there any OOS result at any time point that has not been investigated and closed?

blocks.zh: 查閱倉庫溫度記錄：過去 12 個月是否有溫度偏差？偏差是否均有影響評估和處置決定記錄？
blocks.en: Review warehouse temperature records: have there been temperature excursions in the past 12 months? Does every excursion have an impact assessment and a documented disposition decision?

blocks.zh: 執行一次快速模擬召回（Mock Recall）：任意選取一個近期批號，計算從下指令到產出完整配送清單需要多少時間。若超過 4 小時，需要改進記錄系統的可查詢性。
blocks.en: Run a quick mock recall: pick any recent lot number and measure how long it takes from issuing the instruction to producing a complete distribution list. If it takes more than 4 hours, the searchability of the record system needs improvement.

blocks.zh: 4.8 Subpart G vs. Subpart H — 對比總覽 Regulatory Comparison
blocks.en: 4.8 Subpart G vs. Subpart H — Regulatory Comparison

blocks.zh: 本節重點總結 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: §211.122：標籤物料入庫即受書面程序管控，含取樣、審查、核准及拒絕記錄。禁止未加差異化的連版標籤；裁切標籤需個別批次識別；廢棄/過期標籤必須銷毀；標籤儲存區須限制存取。
blocks.en: §211.122: Labeling materials are under written procedural control from the moment of receipt, including sampling, examination, and records of approval and rejection. Gang-printed labeling without differentiation is prohibited; cut labels need individual lot identification; obsolete/outdated labels must be destroyed; label storage areas must have restricted access.

blocks.zh: §211.125：標籤發放只能由授權人員執行；帶批號剩餘標籤必須銷毀（不可退庫）；標籤調和差異必須調查。執行 100% 在線檢查可豁免調和義務，與 eBR 和 21 CFR Part 11 整合是現代合規的最佳路徑。
blocks.en: §211.125: Labeling may be issued only by authorized personnel; excess labels bearing lot numbers must be destroyed (not returned to stock); label reconciliation variances must be investigated. Performing 100% in-line examination exempts the line from reconciliation, and integration with eBR and 21 CFR Part 11 is the best path to modern compliance.

blocks.zh: §211.130：每次包裝/標籤操作前須執行有記錄的線清（§211.130(e)），由操作員和 QA 雙重確認；空間或物理隔離防止不同產品同時操作時的混淆。
blocks.en: §211.130: A documented line clearance (§211.130(e)) must be performed before every packaging/labeling operation, with two-person confirmation by the operator and QA; spatial or physical separation prevents mix-ups when different products are processed at the same time.

blocks.zh: §211.132：OTC 人用藥品（含兩段式硬膠囊，強制兩個防竄改特徵）須使用防竄改包裝，並在標籤上顯著聲明防竄改機制；皮膚科、牙膏、胰島素和錠劑豁免。
blocks.en: §211.132: OTC human drug products (including two-piece hard capsules, which require two tamper-evident features) must use tamper-evident packaging and carry a prominent label statement of the tamper-evident mechanism; dermatological products, dentifrices, insulin, and lozenges are exempt.

blocks.zh: §211.137：有效期必須由穩定性測試數據（§211.166 + ICH Q1A/Q1E）決定，並與標籤儲存條件綁定（§211.137(b)）；重組藥品需標示重組前後有效期；CDMO 對有效期正確性負 CGMP 責任，品質協議須明確責任分工。
blocks.en: §211.137: The expiration date must be determined from stability test data (§211.166 + ICH Q1A/Q1E) and tied to the labeled storage conditions (§211.137(b)); reconstituted drugs must state the expiration dating before and after reconstitution; the CDMO bears CGMP responsibility for the correctness of the expiration date, and the Quality Agreement must define the division of responsibility.

blocks.zh: §211.142：倉儲條件（溫度、濕度、光線）須維持產品品質；隔離產品須有效防止未授權使用；溫度偏差需有完整調查（MKT 計算 + 影響評估）和 QA 書面處置決定。
blocks.en: §211.142: Warehousing conditions (temperature, humidity, light) must maintain product quality; quarantined product must be effectively prevented from unauthorized use; temperature excursions require a complete investigation (MKT calculation + impact assessment) and a written QA disposition decision.

blocks.zh: §211.150：配送遵循 FIFO/FEFO 原則（暫時例外需 QA 核准）；配送記錄須包含收貨人完整資訊，能在 72 小時內支持完整批次追溯以執行召回；CDMO 須在品質協議中明確記錄保存責任和承運商 GDP 資格評估義務。
blocks.en: §211.150: Distribution follows the FIFO/FEFO principle (temporary exceptions require QA approval); distribution records must contain complete consignee information and support complete batch traceability within 72 hours for recall execution; the CDMO must set out in the Quality Agreement its record retention responsibility and its obligation to assess carrier GDP qualification.
